justifications.type_expressiveness: Good use of enums for Expr/Value/BinOp/UnaryOp/EvalError, but TypeError carries a String payload rather than a structured variant capturing the operator and operand types.
justifications.error_handling: Typed EvalError with three meaningful variants and no panics in library paths, though TypeError uses stringly-typed messages and tokenize uses unwrap() on UTF-8 slices without a documented reason.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public API is clean and Display/Debug are implemented, but there are no doc comments on any public items and ParseError exposes raw public fields including a String message.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, matches!, and proper enum dispatch, though the env is a Vec of (String, Value) with cloning rather than a borrowed scope and manual byte-indexing in the lexer is somewhat low-level.
